english.title: Make false / misleading statement in purported compliance with requirement under ss. 193 / 194
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in purported compliance with a requirement under section 193 or 194 of the Enterprise Act 2002,

(A)_[made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading]_
(B)_[recklessly made a statement which was false or misleading]_

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years Imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
